Eight comments

The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred

I wrote this for the Facebook group of the same name.
As many will note, the opening motif of the 3rd part was pinched from The Braes of Locheil.
It was exactly what the tune needed at that point, and nothing else would serve.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on December 22nd, 2022.

Re: The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred

The dotted groups of three notes of the same pitch represent a “long roll” on Irish traditional instruments and a quarternote/grip/eighthnote figure on the Highland pipes.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on December 23rd, 2022.

The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred, X:2

Highland pipe 6/8 March version.

Sorry for the leumluath/grip the ABC program adds a little tie which obviously wouldn’t appear in a proper pipe score.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on December 30th, 2022.

Re: The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred

“As many will note, the opening motif of the 3rd part was pinched from The Braes of Locheil.”

Reverse the A and C, Richard, and the first two bars are identical to those in the 3rd part of MacLeod of Mull.
(But maybe Donald MacLeod pinched the first bar from Braes of Lochiel for MacLeod of Mull as well!)

↳ Posted by DonaldK on December 30th, 2022.

Re: The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred

I was thinking Donald MacLean of Lewis too, I think that’s the 6/8 that starts

ABG A3

same motif but moved down to the key of A.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on December 31st, 2022.

The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred, X:3

Strathspey version. Just two parts for now.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on February 5th, 2023.

Re: The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred

As you’ll hear, on the Play Audio you have to slow it down almost as far as you can.
The things ordinarily notated as “triplets” in Highland pipe Strathspeys I’ve written as two sixteenths and an eighth, which is much closer, with Play Audio, to how they are usually played.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on February 5th, 2023.

Re: The Ancient And Honourable Order Of The Highland Hundred

All four parts of the Strathspey posted, Leumluaths added for pipers (the Play Audio doesn’t know what to make of them) the time signature put to the correct 4/4 and 1st and 2nd endings put throughout.

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on February 15th, 2023.
